messages:
Maya (SE): Hey team — Sunbridge trial cutover is scheduled for next Wed EOD. Quick async sync: we need staging validation done by Tue 3pm PT, CR owners assigned, and a final 2-hour integration window for the cutover. Can owners ack?
Ben (AE): Ack from sales side. I'll coordinate customer side for a 30min dry-run Tue afternoon.
Alex (Eng): @Maya I can own the staging validation. I booked staging slot: `staging-gpu-03` Tue 1–4pm. Will run full end-to-end with S3, auth, and metrics.
Sophie (SWE): I can do the CR review for the integration adapter. Please ping me the PR. ETA Tue morning.
Priya (Platform): Heads up — logging ingestion schema change from our side needs to land before Tue 12pm or events will drop during the test. I can cut the deploy Mon night.
Ben (AE): @Priya noted. Is there any customer-facing config they need to change for SAML cert rotation?
Priya (Platform): Yes — Sunbridge needs to upload the new cert to their IdP by Tue 11am. Ben, can you confirm with them?
Ben (AE): Will confirm and get back before EOD today.
Maya (SE): Success criteria I'm tracking: 1) request latency under 400ms p95 on staging, 2) no dropped events, 3) embeddings parity within 0.5% vs baseline. If any fail, we rollback.
Alex (Eng): For the latency test, I'll run this health check after the integrate job:
```
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \ 
  https://staging.api.redwood-inference.internal/v1/predict \ 
  -d '{"input":"healthcheck"}'
```
Sophie (SWE): PR is here: https://git.internal/rw/sunbridge-adapter/pull/212 — assigned to @Sophie for final review, @Alex for integration tests.
DeployBot: Scheduled deploy to `platform-logging` on 2024-06-03T02:00:00Z (Mon night).
Priya (Platform): After DeployBot runs, I'll post the verification checklist in this thread.
Ben (AE): Also proposing a short canary ramp: 10% traffic first 30min, monitor errors and latency, then 100% if green. Thoughts? :thumbsup:
Maya (SE): Agree with canary. Sophie — can you add an alert for embedding drift >0.5% during the ramp?
Sophie (SWE): Will add alert rule to the trial dashboard.
Alex (Eng): One more thing — CR owners: integration adapter PR -> Sophie, auth + deploy -> Priya, staging tests -> Alex.
Maya (SE): Excellent. If everyone can drop a final ack in here once cert is confirmed and PRs are merged, I'll lock the cutover slot.
Ben (AE): Confirmed with customer: cert upload scheduled Tue 10:30am PT.
Sophie (SWE): PR merged.
Priya (Platform): Deploy done (per DeployBot). Verifying now.
Alex (Eng): Staging run completed — latency 320ms p95, no dropped events in 2h test.
Maya (SE): All checks green — locking cutover window. Thanks all.
Maya (SE): Follow-up: we'll do a short post-mortem doc after the cutover (2-3 bullets), assign owner for that in case anything crops up.
